sources.scope: Author tutorial: historical transport couplings, held-out interpolation and growth inputs.
Marginal scoring and prior growth sections, lines719-815, including species-specific marker availability and rate sensitivity.

hypothesis: Past proliferation/apoptosis expression can supply uncertain growth priors to unbalanced transport. The prepared equal-per-stage sample counts cannot be treated as biological growth.
implementation_before_training: Retrieve and pin authoritative mouse proliferation/apoptosis gene sets, record exact overlap and expression normalization.
Fit and audit marker scores on permitted past cells only, including expression-matched control genes.
Compare neutral-growth balanced control against bounded growth sensitivities and unbalanced transport on historical adjacent stages.
Specify how past transport/growth is extrapolated for one day; published interpolation does not establish extrapolation accuracy.
Freeze all proposals before evaluation; record four actual metrics, fixed sampling seeds, solver convergence, marginal residuals and failed settings.
limitations: Signatures are growth proxies, not calibrated embryonic birth/death measurements.
Prepared population sampling and historical annotation can bias estimates.
Mouse embryonic rates must not be assumed equal to human reprogramming defaults.
This is an unresolved research path, not a proven improvement or executed experiment.
